findings.title: Table "profiles" created without Row-Level Security enabled
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one critical security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: supabase/migrations/20240101000000_init.sql:1
Issue: Table "profiles" created without Row-Level Security enabled (CWE-285, A01:2025)
What to change: Enable RLS and add policies: ALTER TABLE public.profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; then define per-row access policies.

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "844f792adfb3".
